title: The Monk Who Watched Them Vote
content:
He had not clicked the proposal. He had only watched it pass.

Two ETH of mixed seed. A democracy module. Four USDC vaults at one hundred percent, the Ethereum Meta Vault at ninety-one. No bug. No cleverer hack. The money left because enough hands raised.

The pilgrim said read the governance docs. The degen called it a rug. Both were looking at the same transaction.

He poured the tea. Code is law, he thought. Today the law was a vote to empty the vault.
mantra: Code is law. The law was a vote.
